item.title: Put me in, coach: Ormond Beach Youth Baseball and Softball Association kicks off T-ball season
item.description: The Ormond Beach Youth Baseball and Softball Association's T-ball league opened with 130 kids on 14 teams on Saturday, March 7.

item.title: Local government DEI-ban heads to DeSantis
item.description: Cities and counties won’t be able to fund or promote diversity, equity, and inclusion programs under a bill headed to Gov. Ron DeSantis.

item.title: Ocean Hammock home sells for $4.9M
item.description: Built in 2011, the house is a 5/5 and has 2 half baths, a pool and 6,117 square feet.

item.title: Events calendar: Attend the Volusia Students Create art reception at OMAM
item.description: What to do this week in Ormond Beach and Palm Coast.

item.title: Letter: No one should ever feel they have no safe option
item.description: 'Florida’s Safe Haven law provides a compassionate, legal and anonymous way to surrender an infant, ensuring the child receives a path to a loving home.'

item.title: Seabreeze boys, Mainland girls place second at Volusia-Flagler Freshman-Sophomore track meet
item.description: Flagler Palm Coast placed third and Mainland fourth in the boys standings. Father Lopez was fifth among girls teams.

item.title: Seventh Judicial Circuit Judge Randell H. Rowe to retire in 2027
item.description: Rowe, the most senior sitting judge in the Seventh Judicial Circuit, has decided not to run for a fifth term.

item.title: Palm Coast man leaves debit card behind after stealing $199 headphones
Florida Senate passes bill allowing armed staff at colleges
item.description: Staffers at state colleges and universities can sign up to carry guns on campus under a bill that passed the Senate.

item.title: Suspect Arrested After $120K Scam Targeting Elderly Palm Coast Woman
item.description: Investigators say the suspect posed as a courier in a tech support scam, collecting two $60,000 cash payments from the victim in Palm Coast parking lots.
